body: View-once media now keeps the original image/video visible under a transparent dim + fine-dot sparkle overlay. Rectangular media gets an arrow+1 cue, all covered media gets a centered flame plate, and full-bleed timestamp/status gets a dark pill plus accent border. Generic iOS Swift build passed; asset catalog/device build was unavailable because CoreSimulator and the attached phone were not visible in this sandbox.
author: Vibe Team
